L49@P1: 32.02: continued
L50@P1: Division. Division of Public Records, Office of the Secretary of the Commonwealth of
L51@P1: Massachusetts.
L52@P1: Governmental Entity. Any agency or municipality as defined in 950 CMR 32.02. It includes any
L53@P1: quasi-governmental agency that is considered a body politic and corporate or public
L54@P1: instrumentality. It does not include the legislature and the judiciary.
L55@P1: Municipality. Cities and towns, local housing, redevelopment or similar authorities. A
L56@P1: consortium, consolidation or combination of entities within a single political subdivision of the
L57@P1: commonwealth or among multiple political subdivisions of the commonwealth shall be deemed
L58@P1: a municipality.
L59@P1: Public Record. All books, papers, maps, photographs, recorded tapes, financial statements,
L60@P1: statistical tabulations, or other documentary materials or data, regardless of physical form or
L61@P1: characteristics, made or received by a governmental entity unless such materials or data fall
L62@P1: within one or more of the exemptions found within M.G.L. c. 4, § 7, clause Twenty-sixth or
L63@P1: other legally applicable privileges.

L65@P1: duties described in 950 CMR 32.00 including coordinating a response to requests for access to
